_comment: Accepted dependency risks. Each entry needs a reason, an owner decision and an expiry; expired entries fail CI.

accepted.reason: Only reachable inside the Expo CLI (developer/CI tooling) when validating local config; not bundled into the app and not fed untrusted network input. No patched zod 3.x exists; fix requires Expo to move @expo/cli to zod >= 4.6.6.
